## Research-hunt contract

Complete this section for a new or extended hunt. Use `N/A` only when the pull
request contains no research claim.

- [ ] `MISSION.md` contains a valid `huntspec` block.
- [ ] `RUNS.md` contains a `runmanifest` for every reported run, including null runs.
- [ ] `RESULTS.md` states limitations and kill conditions that fired.
- [ ] `hunts/README.md` names the hunt directory.
- [ ] Every quantitative mathematical claim has a test or an explicit hedge.
- [ ] Structure claims faced a structure-matched rival.
- [ ] Prior art was searched before proposing novelty language, or novelty is not claimed.
- [ ] The authoring agent did not assign evidentiary status to its own output.

Contribution check:

```text
paste the output of scripts/71_contribution_check.py, or explain why N/A
```

## Safety and scope

- [ ] No credential, private prompt or personal data is included.
- [ ] The change is confined to the smallest relevant area.
- [ ] Generated artifacts needed for reproduction are pinned or checksummed.
